entries.title: Psalms 45:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. Set to "The Lillies." A Contemplation of the sons of Korah. A Song of Love.>> My heart is overflowing with a good theme; I recite my composition concerning the King; My tongue [is] the pen of a ready writer.

entries.title: Psalms 45:2
segments: You are fairer than the sons of men; Grace is poured upon Your lips; Therefore God has blessed You forever.

entries.title: Psalms 45:3
segments: Gird Your sword upon [Your] thigh, O Mighty One, With Your glory and Your majesty.

entries.title: Psalms 45:4
segments: And in Your majesty ride prosperously because of truth, humility, [and] righteousness; And Your right hand shall teach You awesome things.

entries.title: Psalms 45:5
segments: Your arrows [are] sharp in the heart of the King's enemies; The peoples fall under You.

entries.title: Psalms 45:6
segments: ¶Your throne, O God, [is] forever and ever; A scepter of righteousness [is] the scepter of Your kingdom.

entries.title: Psalms 45:7
segments: You love righteousness and hate wickedness; Therefore God, Your God, has anointed You With the oil of gladness more than Your companions.

entries.title: Psalms 45:8
segments: All Your garments are scented with myrrh and aloes [and] cassia, Out of the ivory palaces, by which they have made You glad.

entries.title: Psalms 45:9
segments: Kings' daughters [are] among Your honorable women; At Your right hand stands the queen in gold from Ophir.

entries.title: Psalms 45:10
segments: ¶Listen, O daughter, Consider and incline your ear; Forget your own people also, and your father's house;

entries.title: Psalms 45:11
segments: So the King will greatly desire your beauty; Because He [is] your Lord, worship Him.

entries.title: Psalms 45:12
segments: And the daughter of Tyre [will come] with a gift; The rich among the people will seek your favor.

entries.title: Psalms 45:13
segments: The royal daughter [is] all glorious within [the palace]; Her clothing [is] woven with gold.

entries.title: Psalms 45:14
segments: She shall be brought to the King in robes of many colors; The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to You.

entries.title: Psalms 45:15
segments: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be brought; They shall enter the King's palace.

entries.title: Psalms 45:16
segments: Instead of Your fathers shall be Your sons, Whom You shall make princes in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 45:17
segments: I will make Your name to be remembered in all generations; Therefore the people shall praise You forever and ever.
